sections.label: About
sections.title: Engineering Better Infrastructure for Poultry Farming
sections.subtitle: ABOUT KEIL
sections.description:
KEIL is a Hyderabad-based engineering and infrastructure company focused on poultry farm development. We combine structural engineering, environmental control systems and practical farm execution to deliver sheds that perform in real operating conditions — not just on paper.

Whether you are setting up a new farm or upgrading an existing facility, KEIL supports you with end-to-end EC shed solutions built for performance, durability and long-term farm profitability.

From planning and shed design through construction, equipment integration and handover, our team stays accountable at every stage.
